_comment: Per-overlay SHA lock for the release-images workflow.
Each entry pins the git commit that the corresponding add-on wheel
is built from at release time. The CI fetches and checks these
SHAs out detached (so a stray branch push can never change what
ships under a given tag) and records the resolved SHA in OCI image
To bump an add-on: replace the SHA with the desired commit id and
open a PR. Tagging vX.Y.Z then publishes wheels built from exactly
the SHA recorded here -- the resulting image label is reproducible.
